UK Airports Face Major Disruption Due to Air Traffic Control Technical Failure

Major UK airports, including Heathrow and Gatwick, experienced significant disruption on Monday due to a technical failure in air traffic control systems. Departures were halted, leading to widespread delays and cancellations affecting tens of thousands of passengers. The issue caused over 1,000 flights to be cancelled or delayed in London. While the exact cause of the technical failure was not immediately specified, reports indicate it was an air traffic control system issue. The disruption is expected to continue, with delays anticipated.
